regions.label: video_details_and_metadata
regions.reason: Video title, channel info, action buttons, and description
observations: Video title: 'Brian Singerman: "If SpaceX Didn't Work, Founders Fund Wouldn't Exist"' with an 'Auto-dubbed' badge beneath it.
Channel info showing profile icon 'S', title 'Sourcery with Molly O'Shea', and subscriber count '68.8k subscribers'.
Interactive action buttons: 'Subscribe', like button showing '314', dislike button, 'Share' button, and an overflow menu '...' button.
Collapsible video description box with stats '12k views 2 months ago Sourcery' and several lines of text summarizing the interview, ending with '...more'.
interpretations: Primary information section below a YouTube video player providing context, channel subscription controls, social engagement actions, and expanded description.

regions.label: sidebar_recommendations
regions.reason: Related video recommendation list on the right rail
observations: A column of recommended/related video items on the right side of the YouTube watch interface
Top filter chip row with options: 'All', 'From the series', 'From Source...'

Five video recommendation cards stacked vertically, each containing a thumbnail on the left, video title, channel name ('Sourcery with Moll...'), view counts, relative timestamps ('2 mo ago', '3 mo ago'), and an 'Auto-dubbed' badge
interpretations: Related video recommendation list tailored to the currently playing video/series.

regions.label: youtube_header_bar

Left side features a hamburger menu button and the YouTube Premium logo with 'IN' region tag

Right of the search bar is a circular voice search button (microphone icon)
Right side features a '+ Create' pill button, a notification bell icon with a red '9+' badge, and a circular user profile avatar with letter 'H'
interpretations: Main application header providing site-wide navigation, search, content creation, notification, and profile management functions.
